value_proposition.text: Kettlemark turns your POS sales into a daily prep list on your phone, so your kitchen preps closer to what it sells and throws out less.

citations.quote: Prep amounts come from your POS sales history.
Kettlemark runs on iPhone and Android phones.
Food thrown out fell from a median 11.2% of purchases ... to 7.9% in weeks 5-8.

proof_points.text: Food thrown out fell from a median 11.2% to 7.9% of purchases in the pilot.

citations.quote: Food thrown out fell from a median 11.2% of purchases ... to 7.9% in weeks 5-8.

proof_points.text: Kitchens on Tillsy or Ordermint get prep amounts straight from their POS sales history.

citations.quote: Prep amounts come from your POS sales history. Kettlemark syncs with Tillsy and Ordermint.

proof_points.text: Amounts follow the last four same weekdays of sales instead of a guess.

citations.quote: from the sales of the last four same weekdays.

pillars.benefit: Finish the prep list in minutes

proof_points.text: The median time to write the daily prep list fell from 35 minutes to 12.

citations.quote: The median time to write the daily prep list fell from 35 minutes to 12 minutes.

proof_points.text: A chef-owner: "The list is on my phone before I get to the kitchen. I just check it and print it."

citations.quote: The list is on my phone before I get to the kitchen. I just check it and print it.

proof_points.text: The list is ready by five in the morning and prints on most kitchen ticket printers.

citations.quote: The list is ready by 5 a.m. and can be printed on most kitchen ticket printers.

pillars.benefit: Know what your kitchen throws out

proof_points.text: Pilot kitchens logged a median 41 waste entries a week, against 6 in their paper logs.

citations.quote: Kitchens logged a median 41 waste entries a week, against 6 in the paper logs before.
